verses.geez: አሌ፡ ሎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይወርዱ፡ ብሔረ፡ ግብጽ፡ ይርድእዎሙ፡ ወይትአመኑ፡ በአፍራሲሆሙ፡ ወበሠረገላቲሆሙ፤ እስመ፡ ምሉእ፡ አፍራሲሆሙ፡ ወበዝኀ፡ ፈድፋደ።
verses.translation: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, who trust in horses and chariots, for they are many; and in horses, which are a great multitude; and have not trusted in the Holy One of Israel, and have not sought the Lord.

translations.lxx: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help, who trust in horses and chariots, for they are many; and in horses, which are a great multitude; and have not trusted in the Holy One of Israel, and have not sought the Lord.
translations.kjv: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
translations.ron: Vai de cei ce se coboară în Egipt după ajutor şi se bizuie pe caii lor şi îşi pun nădejdea în mulţimea carelor şi în puterea călăreţilor, dar nu-şi aţintesc privirea către Sfântul lui Israel şi nu caută pe Domnul.
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ οἱ καταβαίνοντες εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐπὶ βοήθειαν, οἱ ἐφʼ ἵπποις πεποιθότες καὶ ἐφʼ ἅρμασιν, ἔστι γὰρ πολλὰ, καὶ ἐφʼ ἵπποις πλῆθος σφόδρα· καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν πεποιθότες ἐπὶ τὸν ἅγιον τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ τὸν κύριον οὐκ ἐζήτησαν·

verses.geez: ወውእቱ፡ ጠቢብ፡ አምጽአ፡ እኪተ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወኢይሔሱ፡ ቃሎ፣፡ ወይትነሣእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ቤተ፡ ዕደው፡ እኩያን፡ ወላዕለ፡ ትውክልቶሙ፡ ከንቱ።
verses.translation: Therefore he has wisely brought evils upon them, and his word shall not be frustrated; and he shall rise up against the houses of wicked men, and against their vain hope,

translations.lxx: Therefore he has wisely brought evils upon them, and his word shall not be frustrated; and he shall rise up against the houses of wicked men, and against their vain hope,
translations.kjv: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
translations.ron: Dar El este înţelept, El face să vină nenorocirea şi nu Îşi ia înapoi cuvintele. El Se ridică împotriva casei celor fără de lege şi împotriva ajutorului celor care săvârşesc nedreptatea.
translations.grk: Καὶ αὐτὸς σοφῶς ἦγεν ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς κακά, καὶ ὁ λόγος αὐτοῦ οὐ μὴ ἀθετηθῇ, καὶ ἐπαναστήσεται ἐπʼ οἴκους ἀνθρώπων πονηρῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ἐλπίδα αὐτῶν τὴν ματαίαν,

verses.geez: ለግብጽ፡ እለ፡ ከንቶሙ፡ እጓለ፡ እመሕያው፡ ወአኮ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈረስ፡ ዘሥጋ፡ ወአኮ፡ ረድኤት፤ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ ያመጽእ፡ እዴሁ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፤ ወይደክሙ፡ እለ፡ ረድእዎሙ፡ ወይትሐጐሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ኅቡረ።
verses.translation: even an Egyptian, a man, and not God; the flesh of horses, and there is no help in them: but the Lord shall bring his hand upon them, and the helpers shall fail, and all shall perish together.

translations.lxx: even an Egyptian, a man, and not God; the flesh of horses, and there is no help in them: but the Lord shall bring his hand upon them, and the helpers shall fail, and all shall perish together.
translations.kjv: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
translations.ron: Egipteanul este om, nu Dumnezeu, caii lui sunt carne şi nu duh. Când Domnul Îşi va întinde mâna Lui, ocrotitorul se va împiedica şi ocrotitul va cădea, iar amândoi împreună vor pieri.
translations.grk: Αἰγύπτιον, ἄνθρωπον καὶ οὐ Θεὸν, ἵππων σάρκας, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι βοήθεια· ὁ δὲ Κύριος ἐπάξει τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ αὐτούς· καὶ κοπιάσουσιν οἱ βοηθοῦντες, καὶ ἅμα πάντες ἀπολοῦνται.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ከማሁ፡ ይቤለኒ፡ እግዚአብሔር፤ በከመ፡ ይጥሕር፡ አንበሳ፡ ወእጓለ፡ አንበሳ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዘይመሥጥ፡ ወይኬልሕ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እስከ፡ ይመልእ፡ አድባረ፡ ቃሉ፤ ወይትመውኡ፡ ወእምብዝኀ፡ መዐቱ፡ ይደነግፁ፣፡ ከማሁ፡ ይወርድ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ይጽባእ፡ በደብረ፡ ጽዮን፡ በውስተ፡ አድባሪሃ።
verses.translation: For thus said the Lord to me, As a lion would roar, or a lion's whelp over prey which he has taken, and cry over it, until the mountains are filled with his voice, and the animals are awe-struck and tremble at the fierceness of his wrath: so the Lord of hosts shall descend to fight upon the mount Sion, even upon her mountains.

translations.lxx: For thus said the Lord to me, As a lion would roar, or a lion's whelp over prey which he has taken, and cry over it, until the mountains are filled with his voice, and the animals are awe-struck and tremble at the fierceness of his wrath: so the Lord of hosts shall descend to fight upon the mount Sion, even upon her mountains.
translations.kjv: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
translations.ron: Că iată ce mi-a grăit Domnul: "Precum leul şi puiul de leu răcnesc asupra prăzii şi împotriva lor se adună toată ceata de păstori şi nu se înfioară de strigătele lor, nici nu se tulbură de mulţimea lor, tot astfel Domnul Savaot Se va pogorî să se războiască pe muntele Sionului şi pe colina lui. Şi duşmanii se vor risipi toţi,
translations.grk: Ὅτι οὕτως εἶπέ μοι Κύριος, ὃν τρόπον βοήσῃ ὁ λέων, ἢ ὁ σκύμνος ἐπὶ τῇ θήρᾳ ᾗ ἔλαβε, καὶ κεκράξῃ ἐπʼ αὐτῇ, ἕως ἂν ἐμπλησθῇ τὰ ὄρη τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡττήθησαν, καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ θυμοῦ ἐπτοήθησαν, οὕτως καταβήσεται Κύριος σαβαὼθ ἐπιστρατεῦσαι ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ Σιὼν, ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ ዘይሰርር፡ ከማሁ፡ ይጸብእ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ በእንተ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም፣፡ ይረድእ፡ ወያድኅን፡ ወይባልሕ፡ ወያሐዩ።
verses.translation: As birds flying, so shall the Lord of hosts defend; he shall defend Jerusalem, and he shall rescue, and save and deliver.

translations.lxx: As birds flying, so shall the Lord of hosts defend; he shall defend Jerusalem, and he shall rescue, and save and deliver.
translations.kjv: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
translations.ron: Ca păsările care zboară. Aşa Domnul Savaot va ocroti Ierusalimul, îl va acoperi, îl va mântui, îl va cruţa, îl va libera".
translations.grk: Ὡς ὄρνεα πετόμενα, οὕτως ὑπερασπιεῖ Κύριος σαβαὼθ, ὑπὲρ Ἱερουσαλὴμ ὑπερασπιεῖ, καὶ ἐξελεῖται, καὶ περιποιήσεται, καὶ σώσει.

verses.geez: ተመየጡ፡ እለ፡ ዕሙቀ፡ ምክረ፡ ትመክሩ፡ ከመ፡ ተዐምፁ።
verses.translation: Turn, ye children of Israel, who devise a deep and sinful counsel.

translations.lxx: Turn, ye children of Israel, who devise a deep and sinful counsel.
translations.kjv: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
translations.ron: Întoarceţi-vă către Acela de Care adâncul vă desparte, copii ai lui Israel!
translations.grk: Ἐπιστράφητε οἱ τὴν βαθείαν βουλὴν βουλευόμενοι καὶ ἄνομον, υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ውእተ፡ አሚረ፡ የዐልውዎሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ፡ ዘወርቅ፡ ወዘብሩር፡ ዘገብሩ፡ በእደዊሆሙ።
verses.translation: For in that day men shall renounce their silver idols and their golden idols, which their hands made.

translations.lxx: For in that day men shall renounce their silver idols and their golden idols, which their hands made.
translations.kjv: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea fiecare din voi veţi da la o parte idolii de argint şi cei de aur pe care i-aii făcut cu mâinile voastre cele păcătoase.
translations.grk: Ὅτι τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀπαρνήσονται οἱ ἄνθρωποι τὰ χειροποίητα αὐτῶν τὰ ἀργυρᾶ, καὶ τὰ χειροποίητα τὰ χρυσᾶ, ἃ ἐποίησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ወይወድቁ፡ አሶር፤ ወአኮ፡ በኲናተ፡ ሰብእ፣፡ ወአኮ፡ መባሕተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘትበልዖሙ፡ ወአኮ፡ እምገጸ፡ ኲናት፡ ዘይጐይዩ።
verses.translation: And the Assyrian shall fall: not the sword of a great man, nor the sword of a mean man shall devour him; neither shall he flee from the face of the sword: but the young men shall be overthrown:

translations.lxx: And the Assyrian shall fall: not the sword of a great man, nor the sword of a mean man shall devour him; neither shall he flee from the face of the sword: but the young men shall be overthrown:
translations.kjv: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
translations.ron: Şi Asiria va cădea în sabie care nu este omenească, va fi nimicită nu de sabia unui muritor. Ea o va lua la fugă în faţa sabiei, iar tinerii vor fi duşi în robie!
translations.grk: Καὶ πεσεῖται Ασσούρ· οὐ μάχαιρα ἀνδρὸς, οὐδὲ μάχαιρα ἀνθρώπου καταφάγεται αὐτὸν, καὶ φεύξεται οὐκ ἀπὸ προσώπου μαχαίρας· οἱ δὲ νεανίσκοι ἔσονται εἰς ἥττημα,

verses.geez: ወኰኵሕ፡ ትውሕጦሙ፡ ወይትመውኡ፤ ወዘሂ፡ አምሠጠ፡ ይሠገር።
verses.translation: for they shall be compassed with rocks as with a trench, and shall be worsted; and he that flees shall be taken. Thus saith the Lord, Blessed is he that has a seed in Sion, and household friends in Jerusalem.

translations.lxx: for they shall be compassed with rocks as with a trench, and shall be worsted; and he that flees shall be taken. Thus saith the Lord, Blessed is he that has a seed in Sion, and household friends in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
translations.ron: De frică întăritura ei va fi nimicită, iar căpeteniile vor fugi din jurul steagului, zice Domnul, a Cărui văpaie este în Sion şi cuptorul în Ierusalim!
translations.grk: πέτρᾳ γὰρ περιληφθήσονται ὡς χάρακι, καὶ ἡττηθήσονται, ὁ δὲ φεύγων ἁλώσεται· τάδε λέγει Κύριος, μακάριος ὃς ἔχει ἐν Σιὼν σπέρμα, καὶ οἰκείους ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.
